html:
SMTO-MEM-0040 — Knowledge can't read this type of file

GUID: 83766d27-3968-5fe1-af5b-39231800d383
Slug: knowledge-unsupported-document-format
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • Knowledge only reads certain kinds of files, such as PDFs, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files, text, web pages and pictures. This file is a different type, so it wasn't added.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the file in the program you normally use and save or export a copy as PDF, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx), CSV, plain text, a web page, or a PNG or JPEG picture. These formats are the ones Knowledge can read; your original file stays as it is.
  2. If the file is already one of these types but its name lacks the right ending, such as .pdf, rename it so the ending matches. SMTO decides the file type from the ending of the file name.
  3. In Knowledge, select Upload documents and choose the new copy. The supported copy can then be read and indexed.

What success looks like

  • The copy appears in the document list and moves to Ready to search; Preview shows its text.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, with the type of file you were adding. Convert or rename a copy, not your only original.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • RagService.import_bytes rejected the file because its extension is not one of the supported Knowledge formats (.pdf, .docx, .pptx, .xlsx, .csv, .txt, .md, .html, .htm, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp).

What this means

  • The extractor does not accept this file type. Exporting a supported copy keeps the original intact. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported unsupported_document_format. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • The exported source is accepted and Preview shows its content.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Convert the file to a supported extension (.pdf, .docx, .pptx, .xlsx, .csv, .txt, .md, .html, .htm, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp) and upload the converted copy. Format is decided by the file name's extension, so a supported format with a wrong or missing extension must be renamed.
  • Export the file as a supported document, text file or image, then upload the exported copy.

Retry and execution caution

  • The exported source is accepted and Preview shows its content.

How to verify the fix

  • The exported source is accepted and Preview shows its content.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
